root: ^Welcome to Wenchwatch Hall, sir. How might I be of assistance?

Start: ^I'm here to see Admiral Charles Hold.
^I'm with the Weekly Wag! And I'm here for the Admiral's big scoop!

c-0: ^Oh- I see. Was the Admiral- expecting you, sir?
^It's just- I wasn't aware of your visit.
^The Admiral asked me to speak with him. I received this letter from him last night.
c-1: ^Oh, you're with the Weekly Wag! How thrilling! The Lady of the House is such a fan of your paper!
^But if you'll excuse me, sir- how have you already heard the news?
^The Admiral asked me to speak with him. I received this letter from him last night.
c-2: ^Dorothy Tendwell, sir. Lady's maid to Lady Theodosia Hold. How might I assist you?

Dorothy: ^Well, sir- I'm afraid you won't be able to speak with the Admiral today.
^Lady, I'm not leaving here without a story!
^I really must insist on seeing him. I won't get paid without a story.

c-0: ^Heavens, I'm not quite sure how to explain-
^Perhaps it's best you just see for yourself...
c-1: ^Well, seeing as you are so insistent I suppose it's best you see for yourself.
c-2: ^Well- if that is the case- perhaps it's best you see for yourself.
